edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The aggregate consideration payable for the Shares shall be the base purchase price agreed by the Parties in the final Purchase Price Schedule, as adjusted pursuant to this Section 1 (as so adjusted, the "Purchase Price"). At Closing, Buyer shall pay to Seller by wire transfer of immediately available funds an amount equal to: (a) the base purchase price; plus (b) Estimated Cash; minus (c) Estimated Indebtedness; plus or minus, as applicable, (d) the amount by which Estimated Working Capital is greater or less than the Target Working Capital; minus (e) the Escrow Amount; and minus (f) any unpaid Seller Transaction Expenses (the "Closing Payment"). Seller shall deliver a good-faith estimated closing statement at least five Business Days prior to Closing setting forth the foregoing amounts in reasonable detail. Within ninety days after Closing, Buyer shall deliver a proposed final closing statement. Seller shall have thirty days to review and dispute such statement. Any unresolved disputed items shall be submitted to an independent accounting firm mutually agreed by the Parties, whose determination shall be final and binding absent manifest error. Any final adjustment shall be paid by Buyer or Seller, as applicable, within five Business Days after final determination. "Working Capital" shall be calculated consistently with the accounting principles, policies and methodologies used in preparing the Company’s most recent balance sheet, excluding Cash, Indebtedness, Tax assets and liabilities, and Seller Transaction Expenses except to the extent expressly included in the agreed working-capital schedule.
edits.name: Purchase price mechanics

edits.text:
4. INDEMNITY. 
(a) From and after Closing, Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless Buyer and its affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, members, managers, partners, employees, successors and permitted assigns, from and against losses actually incurred by them arising out of: (i) any breach of Seller’s representations and warranties in this Agreement; (ii) any breach of Seller’s covenants in this Agreement; (iii) any Seller Transaction Expenses or Indebtedness not reflected in the final Purchase Price calculation; and (iv) any liabilities of the Company relating to periods prior to Closing that were not disclosed in the disclosure schedules or reflected or reserved for in the financial statements delivered to Buyer, but solely to the extent such liabilities would constitute a breach of a representation or warranty or are otherwise expressly indemnifiable under this Agreement.
(b) The representations and warranties shall survive for eighteen months after Closing, except that fundamental representations relating to organization, authority, title to the Shares, capitalization, brokers and taxes shall survive until sixty days after expiration of the applicable statute of limitations. Covenants shall survive in accordance with their terms or, if no term is specified, for twelve months after Closing.
(c) Seller shall not be liable for indemnification claims under Section 4(a)(i) or Section 4(a)(iv) unless and until aggregate indemnifiable losses exceed an amount equal to 0.75% of the base purchase price, whereupon Seller shall be liable only for losses in excess of such amount. Seller’s aggregate liability for claims under Section 4(a)(i) and Section 4(a)(iv) shall not exceed 10% of the base purchase price. The foregoing basket and cap shall not apply to claims arising from fraud, intentional misrepresentation, willful misconduct, breaches of fundamental representations, breaches of covenants, or purchase price adjustment matters, provided that Seller’s aggregate liability shall not exceed the Purchase Price except in the case of fraud.
(d) At Closing, Buyer shall deposit with a mutually acceptable escrow agent an amount equal to 10% of the base purchase price to secure Seller’s indemnification obligations under this Section 4. The escrow shall be held pursuant to a customary escrow agreement. Fifty percent of the remaining escrow balance, less pending claims, shall be released to Seller on the twelve-month anniversary of Closing, and the balance, less pending claims, shall be released on the eighteen-month anniversary of Closing.
(e) A party seeking indemnification shall provide written notice describing the claim in reasonable detail, the provisions alleged to have been breached or giving rise to indemnity, and the estimated amount of losses, if then known. For third-party claims, Seller shall have the right to assume and control the defense with counsel reasonably satisfactory to Buyer, provided Seller acknowledges its indemnity obligation subject to the limitations in this Agreement and diligently conducts the defense. Buyer may participate with separate counsel at its own expense. Seller shall not settle any third-party claim without Buyer’s consent if the settlement imposes non-monetary obligations on Buyer or the Company, does not include a full release, or admits wrongdoing by Buyer or the Company. The indemnified party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate losses and shall not recover duplicative amounts, including amounts recovered under insurance or from third parties.
edits.name: Indemnity limitations and procedure
